In Zapier, search for TaskLane and connect it using your API key, which you can generate under Settings > API.
A workspace is the top-level container for your whole team, while a board lives inside a workspace and holds the tasks for a single project or team. You can have many boards per workspace.
Select the task and press Cmd+D on Mac or Ctrl+D on Windows/Linux to duplicate it.
Time zones are set at the workspace level (Settings > General). There is no per-project time zone setting; due dates render in the workspace time zone.
